items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Billy Strayhorn was playing congas... I was playing piano... Billy Strayhorn wrote some, Mercer wrote some.

ctx.x: Yes. In New York. A brilliant arranger. In fact he's a brilliant man all around. And he taught me to get away from the piano, not to be insecure. And the other person who taught me that was Billy Strayhorn.
